story.subtitle: Our Story
story.desc: PetCare wasn't built in a boardroom. It was formed at 2 AM, on a kitchen floor, by a pet parent who just wanted the best for his best friend.
story.origin_p1: In 2018, our founder Kha noticed that his 10-year-old Labrador, Max, was losing energy despite eating 'premium' food. After months of research and consulting vets, he discovered that most 'healthy' pet food was anything but.
story.origin_p2: Frustrated by the lack of transparent, vet-certified options, he started sourcing food directly from ethical farms, testing recipes with a local animal nutritionist.
story.origin_p3: Word spread. Within a year, the initial shared list became a long waiting list. PetCare was born.

faq.subtitle: Help Center
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about PetCare — orders, products, returns, and more.
faq.still_help_desc: Our support team is online Mon-Sat, 8am-6pm. We usually reply within 2 hours.

items.a: Standard delivery takes 2–4 business days. We offer next-day express delivery for orders placed before 12 PM in HCMC and Hanoi. National shipping usually reaches all 63 provinces within 5 business days.
Yes! Orders over $50 qualify for free standard shipping. We also frequently have free shipping promos for new customers — check the homepage banner for the latest offer.
Absolutely. Once your order ships, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking link. You can also view your order status at any time in the Account → Orders tab.

items.q: What if my order arrives damaged?
items.a: We're so sorry if that happens. Please take photos of the damaged item and contact us within 48 hours of delivery. We'll send a free replacement or issue a full refund — no questions asked.
We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy for all unopened, unused products in their original packaging. Just contact our support team to start the return.

items.q: Can I return opened food if my pet doesn't like it?
items.a: Yes! We stand by our products 100%. If your pet refuses a food product within 14 days of receipt, contact us and we'll refund the store credit or help you find a replacement — even for opened goods.
After receiving and inspecting your return, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days. The time for the funds to reach your account depends on your bank, usually 7–10 days.
Every single product on PetCare is vetted by our internal board of over 30 licensed veterinarians and nutritionists. Products that don't meet our standards never make it to our shelves.
Yes — we have a dedicated 'Grain Free' category in the shop. Use the category filters on the Shop page to browse all grain-free food, treats, and snacks.

items.q: Where are your products sourced from?
items.a: We source from trusted local farms and global suppliers that meet our strict ethical and sustainability standards. Look for the 'Ethically Sourced' badge on each product page.

items.q: Do you have products for cats?
items.a: We do! While we started with dog nutrition, we've expanded our cat range significantly. Filter by 'Cat' in the Shop or browse the category pages to see all feline-friendly products.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), bank transfers, and popular e-wallets including MoMo and ZaloPay. Cash on Delivery (COD) is also available in eligible areas.
Yes. All payments are processed through encrypted, PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways. We never store your full card details on our servers.

items.q: How do I update my profile or address?
items.a: Log in and navigate to Account → Settings. You can update your name, phone number, shipping address, and city at any time. Changes will apply immediately to future orders.

items.q: Can I order without an account?
items.a: Currently, creating a free account is required to place an order — this allows you to track deliveries, manage wishlists, and view your order history. Sign up takes less than a minute!
